pages.title: Christmas Nativity Scene Coloring Page
pages.description: Mary and Joseph lean over Baby Jesus on this printable coloring page, with a straw-filled manger, Joseph’s curved staff, and an eight-point star above the stable.

pages.title: Easy Nativity Scene in a Stable Coloring Page
pages.description: A five-point star tops the simple stable on this printable coloring page, where Mary and Joseph watch over the swaddled baby in a smooth-sided manger.

pages.title: Cute Nativity Scene with a Lamb Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Jesus reaches toward a curly-fleeced lamb on this printable coloring page, while Mary watches from beside the manger with straw spilling over its rim.

pages.title: Detailed Nativity Scene in Bethlehem Coloring Page
pages.description: In this detailed printable coloring page, shepherds and gift-bearing Wise Men gather around the manger, with a donkey in front and Bethlehem’s rooftops behind the stable.

pages.title: Mary Holding Baby Jesus Coloring Page
pages.description: Mary cradles Baby Jesus in this printable coloring page, with her long veil framing their faces as he looks up from his folded blanket.

pages.title: Mary and Joseph Kneeling Beside Baby Jesus Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Mary and Joseph kneeling beside Baby Jesus, with Mary’s hands clasped and Joseph resting one hand on the straw-filled manger.

pages.title: Nativity Stable with a Donkey and an Ox Coloring Page
pages.description: A long-eared donkey and a horned ox flank a mound of hay on this printable coloring page, beneath exposed rafters in the Nativity stable.

pages.title: Star of Bethlehem Shines Over the Stable Coloring Page
pages.description: The eight-point Star of Bethlehem fills the sky on this printable coloring page, above a small stable with a hay-filled manger and houses on rolling hills.

pages.title: Angel Gabriel Visits Mary Coloring Page
pages.description: Angel Gabriel extends an open hand toward Mary on this printable coloring page, showing his layered wings and the arched window above her bench.

pages.title: Empty Manger with Hay Coloring Page
pages.description: An empty manger piled with hay fills this printable coloring page, framed by an open stable with a peaked roof and wood grain on its beams.

pages.title: Angel Appears to the Shepherds Coloring Page
pages.description: A winged angel greets two shepherds on this printable coloring page, with three sheep gathered at their feet and an eight-pointed star overhead.

pages.title: Shepherd Boy Holding a Lamb Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a young shepherd cradling a lamb, with his curved crook propped against a fence beside the winding path.

pages.title: Shepherds Visit Baby Jesus Coloring Page
pages.description: One shepherd kneels beside Baby Jesus in this printable coloring page, while another holds a staff and a lamb sleeps at the foot of the manger.

pages.title: Three Wise Men Follow the Star on Camels Coloring Page
pages.description: The Three Wise Men ride camels beneath an eight-pointed star in this printable coloring page, passing a palm tree and domed buildings on the hillside.

pages.title: Three Wise Men Bring Gifts to Baby Jesus Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, the Three Wise Men bring two decorated vessels and a chest to Baby Jesus as Mary watches beside the manger.

pages.title: Nativity Angel Spreads Its Wings Above the Stable Coloring Page
pages.description: A haloed angel spreads its wings above the stable in this printable coloring page, while Mary and Joseph kneel beside Baby Jesus in the manger.

pages.title: Nativity Scene Cutout Figures Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features six Nativity cutouts with rectangular tabs, including Mary, Joseph, Baby Jesus in a manger, a shepherd, an angel, and a lamb.

pages.title: Children Perform in a Christmas Nativity Play Coloring Page
pages.description: Five children perform a Christmas Nativity play in this printable coloring page, with a prop manger, tied-back curtains, and a crowned Wise Man holding a chest.

pages.title: Stained Glass Nativity Window Coloring Page
pages.description: A stained-glass Nativity window fills this printable coloring page, with Mary and Joseph beside the manger under a star framed by radiating panes.

pages.title: Nativity Scene Mandala Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Mary, Joseph, and Baby Jesus at the center of a Nativity mandala ringed with four stars and leafy sprigs.

pages.title: Nativity Christmas Card Coloring Page
pages.description: Holly leaves and berries frame this printable coloring page for a Nativity Christmas card, with Mary and Joseph watching over Baby Jesus beneath a radiant star.
